---
name: grill-me
description: Interrogate requirements, edge cases, and architectural decisions before implementation.
---

Use `docs/spec.md`, `docs/tickets.md`, and the relevant files in `docs/agents/` as context. Ask concise, high-value questions that expose ambiguity in behavior, data contracts, acceptance criteria, security, accessibility, or testing. Group questions by decision area and stop once the implementation can be specified clearly. Do not edit files.
